NEW SECTION . 135.90 Rural birthing hospital fund. 5 1. As used in this section, “birthing hospital” means the 6 same as defined in section 135.131. 7 2. A rural birthing hospital fund is created in the state 8 treasury under the control of the department. Moneys in the 9 fund are appropriated to the department to distribute grants 10 for the purpose of expanding access to birthing hospitals 11 across the state, including funding the establishment of 12 birthing hospitals in rural areas of the state that experienced 13 closures of birthing hospitals from July 1, 2021, through July 14 1, 2026. 15 3. Notwithstanding section 8.33, moneys appropriated in 16 this section that remain unencumbered or unobligated at the 17 close of the fiscal year shall not revert but shall remain 18 available for expenditure for the purposes designated until the 19 close of the succeeding fiscal year. 20 4.
